nodes.name: analytics.service.ts

nodes.name: AnalyticsService
nodes.summary: Root-scoped Angular service providing a track() method that calls the Plausible analytics window function with event name and optional properties.

nodes.name: timeline.scss

nodes.name: polyfills.ts
nodes.summary: Angular polyfills entry point loading zone.js and any browser compatibility shims needed for the application.
